description: Narrow W005 active slice for raw TreeCalc children formulas on the OxFml host syntax packet path, including the focused qualified children base-query forms. This is migration evidence only and does not activate the broader W004 set-membership surface.

cases.name: Raw =SUM(@CHILDREN) publishes the sum of direct children
cases.note: The runner executes the node's original formula text through OxCalcTreeContext; it does not parse this reference locally.

cases.name: Raw =SUM(.*) publishes the sum of direct children
cases.note: The runner executes the node's original formula text through OxCalcTreeContext; it does not parse this reference locally.

cases.name: Raw =SUM(base.@CHILDREN) publishes the sum of the base node's direct children
cases.note: DnaTreeCalc consumes OxCalc's public qualified-children base-query packet and resolves only the base token against the tree model.

cases.name: Raw =SUM(base.*) publishes the sum of the base node's direct children
cases.note: DnaTreeCalc does not construct private span keys or parse the full formula; OxCalc owns the scanned query packet and reference carrier.
